fitoutStages.name: Brief and Space Analysis
fitoutStages.description: Capture client requirements: headcount, zones needed, budget, timeline, move date, aesthetic preference
fitoutStages.TCDRole: AI Office Planner + Workplace Strategy Consultant
fitoutStages.output: Project brief document + preliminary space plan

fitoutStages.name: Design and Space Planning
fitoutStages.description: CAD layout production, furniture overlay on floor plan, zone identification and circulation confirmation
fitoutStages.TCDRole: Internal design/planning team or design partner

fitoutStages.name: Product Specification and Quoting
fitoutStages.description: Specific product selection by SKU, finish and fabric choices, pricing by tier, quote production
fitoutStages.output: Itemised project quote (3 tiers where appropriate)

fitoutStages.name: Finish and Fabric Confirmation
fitoutStages.description: Sample delivery to client, client selection of colours/finishes/fabrics
fitoutStages.TCDRole: Account manager — proactively dispatch samples before client asks
fitoutStages.duration: 1–2 weeks (where most projects stall — manage actively)

fitoutStages.name: Order Placement and Manufacture
fitoutStages.description: Deposit received, order placed with suppliers, manufacture begins

fitoutStages.name: Delivery Coordination
fitoutStages.description: Building access confirmed, lift dimensions verified, delivery window booked with building management
fitoutStages.output: Delivery brief distributed to installation team

fitoutStages.name: Installation
fitoutStages.description: Furniture delivered and assembled in sequence. Storage → workstation frames → desktops → chairs → accessories
fitoutStages.TCDRole: Installation team + PM on site for projects >$80k

fitoutStages.name: Handover and Warranty
fitoutStages.description: Walk-through with client, defect list closed within 72 hours, warranty registered, handover documentation issued
fitoutStages.output: Signed handover, registered warranty, referral conversation

criticalPathItems: Finish/fabric confirmation is where 80% of projects stall — proactively send samples before client asks
Practical Completion date from builder is the anchor — everything works backwards from this date
Installation slot must be booked 4–6 weeks in advance — cannot be assumed available
Power/data installation by electrician must be complete before workstation install can finalise

fastTrackRules.definition: Under 6 weeks from order to delivery
fastTrackRules.viableIf: All products confirmed in-stock at time of order
fastTrackRules.premium: Logistics and urgency premium should be applied — 15–25% on freight/installation
fastTrackRules.neverPromise: Never commit to fast-track without confirming stock availability with supplier first
